purpose: Prospective narrow rejection screen for a new temporal rule. All media preexists; no model result used for selection. No product integration or validation claim.

exclusions.comparison: Exact bytes excluded; shared parent ancestry explicitly disclosed.

selection.positiveQualityAssignment: Sort original parents by SHA256(sightengine-temporal-v1-quality|originalSHA), cycle original/mild/severe, four per quality.
selection.sameParentCheck: Raw original receipted Veo; scored separately.

advancementCriteria.technical: All25 cases complete with valid schema, coverage, accounting and exact outgoing bytes; any error, unattempted case or operational stop fails advancement.
advancementCriteria.documentedNegative: Zero AI alerts among12 files and six parent groups; at least10/12 files and5/6 parents must be no_clear_indicators rather than Inconclusive.
advancementCriteria.publisherAssignedAi: At least10/12 AI alerts overall and at least3/4 in each assigned quality. Inconclusive/no_clear_indicators/error count as non-detections; publisher-assigned recall is reported separately.
advancementCriteria.receiptBackedSameParent: Raw Veo must be AI; report1/1 or0/1 separately with shared-parent qualification.
advancementCriteria.scope: A pass only supports considering narrow experimental integration or a separately frozen next test; no calibrated/population/independent or subsecond/mixed-positive validation claim.
advancementCriteria.classificationFailure: Finish remaining frozen cases if operational safeguards remain valid. Preserve failure; no score-aware replacement, threshold rescue or rerun.

reporting.parentRule: Within each parentId: any technical failure fails the parent; otherwise any persistent_ai_indicators => alert; else any inconclusive => inconclusive; otherwise all no_clear_indicators => clear. Preserve isolated alerts and reviewRequired even in a persistent-positive case.
required: Publisher-assigned recall overall and by quality, including abstentions as non-detections
Documented-negative false alerts and usable coverage by file and parent
All isolated alerts and persistent sample runs with raw timestamps and scores
All technical errors, unattempted cases, actual operations and latency
No population confidence or independence claim from curated dependent sources
missingCoverage: No eligible verified new mixed-positive clip after exact-byte exclusions.
Only one receipt-backed generated parent, already consumed in another encoding.
No actual Instagram round trip or user-Reel call in this study.

preparationAmendment.reason: Pre-inference schema binding to the separately reviewed fixed aggregator. No case selection, media, score threshold, sample cadence, consecutive rule or acceptance threshold changed. V1 remains preserved and unexecuted.

api.normalization: Divide raw info.position by1000 to supply positionSeconds; preserve original values and received order.

decisionMeaning.persistent_ai_indicators: A valid persistent run exists; any additional isolated alerts stay unresolved and reviewRequired remains true.
decisionMeaning.inconclusive: Isolated positives without a persistent run, or technical/coverage failure. Technical failure must be reported separately and fails advancement.
decisionMeaning.no_clear_indicators: No positive samples with complete coverage. Not proof of real origin or exclusion of AI between samples.

policy.scope: Narrow uncalibrated development rejection screen. No subsecond, new mixed-positive, population or independent validation claim.
